text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both gaining modestly on the day, with ETH slightly outpacing BTC, suggesting some rotation into altcoins despite the subdued price action. The Extreme Fear reading (25) paired with declining momentum over the past week signals capitulation sentiment, though the $64B in daily volume remains relatively healthy and BTC dominance holding near 60% shows no panic exodus from the largest assets. Current conditions reflect defensive positioning rather than conviction selling—risk appetite is depressed but not collapsing.
